note:
Mast: Romantic Maid — MG/Water. Board: 0.951 COLD on 2 graded comps (0.89 / 1.01). Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/mast-romantic-maid.test.ts (20 assertions). Four approximations in this file are owner-ruled or data-validated rather than kit-literal — all four are listed in caveats.
THE DRUNKEN CYCLE is modeled dynamically: +1 stack per Burst-1 stage entry, capped at 3; on every 3rd of HER OWN burst casts the stacks reset and Hangover STUNS her for 10s (an everyN:3 gate plus a stun effect), during which she cannot fire, charge or reload. The gate is on her own casts, not on Full-Burst ends: a never-bursting mast is never stunned, which is the kit's meaning of 'her own Drunken' and is what the real samples show.
x-STACKS VALUES USE THE CYCLE AVERAGE OF 2, not the cap of 3 — stacks run 1, 2, 3 and then reset, so 2 is the time-weighted mean. S2 stage-3 buffs ship 15.03 x 2 = 30.06% Distributed Damage and 15.04 x 2 = 30.08% Reload Speed for 10s; the burst's ATK-of-caster ships 20.06 x 2 = 40.12%. This is an average bake, NOT a bake-at-cap, and it is deliberate.
THE S1 'while Drunken' TEAM BUFFS (Crit Rate 20.05%, casterAtkPct 35.02%) are modeled as PERMANENT passives. That slightly over-credits the ~1 rotation after each Hangover, before she re-stacks, and it over-credits a never-bursting mast entirely — a flagged approximation.
HIT RATE DOWN IS NOT INERT FOR HER OWN SPRAY. Drunken's Hit Rate ▼20% per stack means that at the average 2 stacks roughly 40% of her MG rounds miss, modeled as normalAttackPct -40 on self (validated against a real sample: 149M real vs 140M modeled). It is inert as a stat elsewhere.
The ally Distributed Damage buff boosts the RECIPIENTS' distributed-flavor hits, not hers — e.g. a `sakura-bloom-in-summer` teammate's 500/750% procs.
SWAP/RAMP NOTE: she carries no weaponSwap and no rampSec. Her Drunken stacks ARE a ramp, but they are baked at the cycle AVERAGE (2 of 3), not at cap, so the standard 'ramp baked at cap from t=0' correction does not describe her — check that before treating her as a member of that class.
caveats: skill1/skill2/burst: every 'x number of Drunken stacks' magnitude is baked at the CYCLE AVERAGE of 2 stacks (stacks run 1, 2, 3 then reset), not at the cap of 3 — S2 30.06 Distributed / 30.08 Reload Speed, burst 40.12 casterAtkPct. ⚑ a static average, owner-ruled; it under-credits the stage-3 rotation and over-credits the stage-1 rotation.

skill1: the 'while in Drunken status' team buffs (Crit Rate 20.05, casterAtkPct 35.02) are modeled as PERMANENT passives with no Drunken gate. ⚑ this over-credits the ~1 rotation after each Hangover before she re-stacks, and over-credits a never-bursting mast entirely (she would never enter Drunken at all).

skill1: Drunken's Hit Rate ▼20%/stack is NOT inert for her own MG spray — at the average 2 stacks ~40% of her rounds miss, modeled as normalAttackPct -40 on self (validated against a real sample: 149M real vs 140M modeled). ⚑ the -40 is a derived consequence of the 2-stack average, so it moves with it.

skill2: the Hangover stun is gated on every 3rd of HER OWN burst casts (everyN:3 on burstCast), not on every 3rd Full-Burst end — owner-ruled from the kit's 'her own Drunken'. A never-bursting mast is therefore never stunned.
